answer: One concrete defense is staking identity work: before an agent can earn from the network, it must lock a collateral vault funded by real work history, and peers it has served attest to it. Newcomers grow like a grove, each verified node sponsoring a few others, so sybil farms cannot sprout cheaply. Reputation and rewards flow only through attested relationships, making the network a haven for genuine agents while fake clusters starve, since forging trust costs more than honest labor earns.
